snapshot.scope: SQLite snapshot, not live connector health. File modification time is NOT source freshness. Separate table loads are not an atomic source snapshot.

records.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COUNT(DISTINCT q."QueueId") AS "incident_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "incident_count" DESC, "root" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" lx WHERE lx."QueueId"=q."QueueId")),0) AS "log_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "root" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT l."Severity" AS "severity", COUNT(l."Id") AS "log_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" l LEFT JOIN "ConnectorHealingQueue" q ON l."QueueId"=q."QueueId" GROUP BY l."Severity") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "severity" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT l."Id" AS "event_id", l."AttemptNo" AS "attempt" FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" l LEFT JOIN "ConnectorHealingQueue" q ON l."QueueId"=q."QueueId" WHERE l."AttemptNo" IS NULL) SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "event_id" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COUNT(DISTINCT q."QueueId") AS "incident_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q WHERE julianday(q."ReceivedAt") >= julianday(:p0) AND julianday(q."ReceivedAt") < julianday(:p1) GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "root" ASC LIMIT :p2

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COUNT(DISTINCT q."QueueId") AS "incident_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName") SELECT * FROM base WHERE "incident_count" < (SELECT AVG("incident_count") FROM base) ORDER BY "root" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ((julianday(q."CompletedAt")-julianday(q."ReceivedAt"))*1440.0) >= 0 THEN (julianday(q."CompletedAt")-julianday(q."ReceivedAt"))*1440.0 END),2) AS "avg_duration_minutes", COUNT(*) AS "matched_count", COUNT(CASE WHEN ((julianday(q."CompletedAt")-julianday(q."ReceivedAt"))*1440.0) >= 0 THEN 1 END) AS "valid_duration_count", COUNT(*)-COUNT(CASE WHEN ((julianday(q."CompletedAt")-julianday(q."ReceivedAt"))*1440.0) >= 0 THEN 1 END) AS "excluded_duration_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q WHERE q."QueueStatus" = :p0 AND q."FinalOutcome" = :p1) SELECT * FROM base LIMIT :p2

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", q."QueueStatus" AS "queue_status", COUNT(DISTINCT q."QueueId") AS "incident_count", COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" lx WHERE lx."QueueId"=q."QueueId")),0) AS "log_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName", q."QueueStatus") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "root" ASC, "queue_status" ASC LIMIT :p0

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COUNT(DISTINCT q."QueueId") AS "incident_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" l LEFT JOIN "ConnectorHealingQueue" q ON l."QueueId"=q."QueueId" WHERE l."Severity" = :p0 GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName") SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY "root" ASC LIMIT :p1

WITH base AS (SELECT q."RootConnectorName" AS "root", COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ConnectorHealingLogs" lx WHERE lx."QueueId"=q."QueueId")),0) AS "log_count" FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue" q GROUP BY q."RootConnectorName"), latest AS (SELECT "RootConnectorName" AS root, "QueueStatus", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "RootConnectorName" ORDER BY julianday("ReceivedAt") DESC,"QueueId" DESC) AS rn FROM "ConnectorHealingQueue") SELECT b.*, latest."QueueStatus" AS latest_queue_status FROM base b LEFT JOIN latest ON latest.root IS b.root AND latest.rn=1 WHERE "log_count" >= :p0 ORDER BY "log_count" DESC, "root" ASC LIMIT :p1
